questions.kp: 与现在事实相反的虚拟
questions.stem: If I ____ you, I would accept the offer.
questions.explain: 与现在事实相反的虚拟条件句：从句用过去式（be 一般用 were），主句用 would / could + 动词原形。我不可能是你，所以用虚拟。
questions.verify: 本单元按“虚拟语气与情态动词”编写，教材各单元的语法项目未核实；请对照教材目录核对。

questions.kp: 与过去事实相反的虚拟
questions.stem: If he had taken my advice, he ____ the mistake.
questions.explain: 从句 had taken 表示与过去事实相反，主句用 would / could + have + 过去分词：当时要是听了我的话，就不会犯错了。

questions.stem: I wish I ____ more time to travel, but I'm too busy now.
questions.explain: wish 后的宾语从句用虚拟语气：对现在的愿望用过去式（had），对过去的遗憾用过去完成式（had had）。这里说的是现在（now）。

questions.kp: suggest 后宾语从句的虚拟
questions.stem: The doctor suggested that he ____ smoking at once.
questions.explain: suggest、insist、order、demand 等表示“建议、要求、命令”时，that 从句用 (should) + 动词原形，should 可以省略，所以是 stop。

questions.stem: You ____ be tired after such a long journey. Sit down and have a rest.
questions.explain: must 用于肯定句表示很有把握的推测（一定）：走了这么远，你一定累了。否定推测用 can't。

questions.stem: You ____ have told me earlier. Now it's too late to do anything.
questions.explain: should have done 表示“本应该做而实际没做”，带有责备的语气。must have done 是对过去的肯定推测（一定做过），与“现在太晚了”矛盾。

questions.kp: It's high time… 句型的虚拟
questions.stem: It's high time we ____ home; it's getting dark.
questions.explain: It is (high) time (that)… 句型中，从句用过去式表示“早该……了”（也可以用 should + 动词原形）。

questions.kp: 与过去事实相反的虚拟
questions.stem: If I ____ (know) her address yesterday, I would have written to her.
questions.explain: yesterday 和主句的 would have written 都说明是与过去事实相反的假设，从句用过去完成时 had known。
